action.text: Hi, it's Hazel from GP Link, sorry I've missed you. You'd enquired with us about GP work in Australia. I'll try you again, or you can grab a time with us using the link we emailed. Speak soon, bye.

post_call_analysis_data.name: outcome
post_call_analysis_data.description: How the call ended. booked = a consultation was booked on the call via the booking tool; link_sent = the booking link was sent instead; callback_requested = they asked to be rung back; not_interested = they declined; not_a_gp = not a doctor / not a GP; wrong_number = wrong person; already_booked = they had already booked; voicemail = voicemail or answering machine; no_answer = nobody spoke; unclear = a person spoke but none of the above clearly applies.

post_call_analysis_data.name: callback_time
post_call_analysis_data.description: If they asked to be called back, when, in their own words. Empty otherwise.

post_call_analysis_data.name: gp_status
post_call_analysis_data.description: Whether they are a practising GP (gp), still in GP training (trainee), not a GP at all (not_a_gp), or it never came up (unknown).

post_call_analysis_data.name: training_finish
post_call_analysis_data.description: If still in training, when they said they finish, in their words. Empty otherwise.

post_call_analysis_data.name: timeframe
post_call_analysis_data.description: When they said they want to move to Australia, in their words. Empty if not discussed.
examples: in two years once the kids finish school

post_call_analysis_data.name: objections
post_call_analysis_data.description: Comma-separated list of the concerns or objections the doctor raised, from: timing, partner, money, moving_costs, remote, city_only, part_time, english_test, old_mrcgp, overseas_trained, other_agency, scam, in_writing, process, family_school, elderly_parents, undecided_country, ai_suspicion, none.

post_call_analysis_data.name: objection_handled
post_call_analysis_data.description: For the main concern raised: did the agent answer it with a specific reason or workaround (handled), only partly or vaguely (partly), ignore it or just repeat the offer (ignored), or no concern was raised (none).

post_call_analysis_data.name: lost_booking_reason
post_call_analysis_data.description: If the doctor was a practising GP (or within three months of finishing) and did not end up booked or sent the link, one sentence on what the agent said or failed to say that cost the booking. Empty if booked, link sent, or not a bookable doctor.
examples: Doctor asked for written info first; agent offered a time instead of saying it is in the confirmation email.

post_call_analysis_data.name: unanswered_questions
post_call_analysis_data.description: Questions the doctor asked that the agent did not answer or answered wrongly, each in a few words, comma-separated. Empty if none.
examples: school fees for dependants, whether Perth has openings

post_call_analysis_data.name: agent_slips
post_call_analysis_data.description: Any of these the agent did: repeated a question, asked two questions at once, used filler like 'great question', mentioned rules or tools, said 'fully qualified', asked whether they are a GP, quoted a salary figure, claimed anyone is fully booked, gave a second goodbye. Comma-separated short labels, or 'none'.
examples: repeated question, two questions at once

post_call_analysis_data.name: notes
post_call_analysis_data.description: One or two sentences a human recruiter needs before the consultation: family situation, preferred locations, concerns raised, questions left unanswered.
examples: Partner is a nurse, two kids, wants Queensland coast. Asked about school fees, not answered.
